title: Generalized Whiting transform and Flux Estimates for Wave Equations in Subextremal Kerr
summary: All recent advances \cite{DRS}, \cite{S-Rita1}, \cite{S-Rita2}, \cite{Millet}, \cite{MaS}, \cite{MaS2} on the boundedness and decay for wave equations on subextremal Kerr spacetimes $\KK(a,m)$, with non-small angular rotation, rely in an essential way on Whiting's groundbreaking discovery of a powerful integro-differential transformation with the help of which he ruled out exponentially growing modes in \cite{W} (see also \cite{Yacov}, \cite{AMPW} and \cite{Rita} for further developments).
